title: Product-scope issue/backlog/RCCA loop was not wired into the pipeline (ingest_defects had zero callers)
body: Defects/issues of a product under construction never reached the canonical IS-* registry with RCCA + paired backlog.

rcca.root_cause: BI-PF-0262 built the registry for product_forge scope; the product-scope bridge (ingest_defects) was written but never called, and legacy stage-audit issues were never folded in.
rcca.corrective: ingest_defects(auto_backlog) + ingest_stage_issues called from _save_issues; stage-ID bug fixed; product_page.issues() + API routes + blueprint.
rcca.preventive: Every scope must exercise the loop; add a product-scope e2e test (mirrors product_forge).
